name: Quad-Grip
body:
Though you are only medium-sized, your powerful arms allow you to treat yourself as a larger creature.

Prerequisite(s): Behemoth Grip, base attack bonus +10

Benefit(s): You count as being one size category larger for the purpose determining what size weapon you can wield if you grip it with multiple arms. If you are a medium creature you can wield a one-handed weapon sized for a large creature in three hands or a two-handed weapon sized for a large creature in four hands with no penalty. You do not gain the benefit of the Behemoth Grip feat while using multiple arms to grip a weapon of a large size category than you could wield without this feat.
